notes: Personal mode needs no stack: run headless with SPARK__INTERFACE__OPEN_BROWSER=false and SPARK__INTERFACE__PORT set to the web port from ports.txt. Server mode: start the sandbox stack (compose_up in ports.txt), then set SPARK__MODE=server and SPARK__DATABASE__URL=postgresql://spark:spark-dev-only@127.0.0.1:<postgres port>/spark and run `spark migrate`. The database test suites start their own PostgreSQL through testcontainers. sentence-transformers downloads its embedding model on first use.
